changes: MemberRoundAssembly composes staged initialization, bound native SSH/RPC, partial resource reconciliation and exact auxiliary teardown.
run_assembled_round holds the existing exclusive Linux journal lock through the signal-aware round runner and final cleanup; it has no default credentials or live interfaces.
MemberSetupBindings connects control-create polling to MemberControlCreation. Each poll retains the original stage request and durable intent.

MemberControlCreation reuses MachineProvisionProviders and LinodeProvisionClient for preflight, request construction, single dispatch and identity-filtered readback. No duplicate cloud-create HTTP implementation was added.
The original create request is encrypted before dispatch. Unknown responses stop creation and retain reconciliation obligations; a missing list entry is not proof of no creation.
Definite provider rejection reuses CloudFailurePolicy classification and retains only safe kind/status/code fields; no raw response message, root password or credential is exported.
Control cleanup accepts the exact native request label/marker as well as the prior pinned control label. Baseline exclusions and full provider identity checks remain enforced.

Native work is stopped before final initialization/DNS receipts are collected. Source identities must agree in both ledgers, task/external IDs must be distinct, and only the approved source/candidate roles are admitted.
Restart during cleanup restores the native transport and the independently persisted delete journal. Partial initialization without a native grant uses the separately pinned setup task channel.
New modules and tests are included in the unarmed adapter/runtime package inventory; package verification retains LF normalization, hash verification and disabled execution flags.

interface_contract.setup: Pinned control-install, runtime-install, private-import, serial sources-initialize, dns-initialize, native-grant and native-ready interfaces. Reconcile must stop or revoke incomplete setup authority and resolve original intents before declaring success.
interface_contract.control: MemberControlCreation.dispatch accepts only the frozen control-create request and its control-readback recovery operation. The caller must hold the round journal lock and supply explicit process-local authorization; the class does not enable persistent or automatic execution settings.
interface_contract.initial_cleanup_scope: Exactly run_id, roles and auxiliary. roles contains only actually resolved source-a/source-b task pins. auxiliary contains exact owned control/DNS/fault/private-file pins and original request IDs, including partial work.
interface_contract.dns_receipts: Final DNS pins must come from the stopped controller's durable verified write receipts, not an arbitrary observed current value. Provider readback still verifies every identity field before deletion.
interface_contract.native_transport: BoundControllerTransport created from the verified native grant with matching run, bundle, start and deadline. No native capability is fabricated for partial initialization.
interface_contract.recovery: Unknown intent resolution is not zero resources. Resource cleanup can complete after evidence export failure, but the acceptance result remains failed.

remaining_before_live: Bind and validate the host installation, private import, DNS initialization and recovery infrastructure interfaces against the new isolated Linux layout. These boundaries were simulated here, not exercised on a host.
Run isolated Linux tests for real permissions, exclusive journal locking, signals and cross-process interface contracts.
Freeze and verify a new complete LF application/node/vendor bundle, then perform separately authorized minimal read-only preflight.
Obtain new explicit execution scope before any live run. This record is not authority to execute R35 or any older round.
